description: Separate reusable printed marking tools for the current modular Ø90/86 tube pattern; not installed avionics parts.
releaseRequirements: Seat the front frame and its nominal tube-contact lands, then apply the pressure shoe. Verify actual tube fit and holding before marking.
Verify the fixed tube-front datum, opposed tool registers and rail overlap against the two source windows and all sixteen radial centers. Keep the base fixed between passes.
Use the printed passages for center transfer. Remove the tools before final drilling, head-seat preparation or powered cutting, and work through one tube wall at a time.
Print every tool in its supplied orientation within the individual printer envelope. Clean the datum faces, mark passages and hardware seats before assembly.
Verify the exact selected screw/nut bearing, thread engagement, tool access and fit on the printed kit. Nominal CAD geometry and slicing do not certify marking accuracy or repeated-use wear.
